01 — Gravity

Ride planets.
Leap through zero-G.

Land on any planet and orbit its surface. Jump off, and you're launched into cold, empty space — where only your trajectory and timing will get you to the next world.

Physics-based mechanics

02 — Danger

30 levels.
Relentless asteroid storms.

Early levels ease you in. By level 20, asteroid swarms rain through space at high speed. Protect your delivery box — every hit damages it, and 3 stars require near-perfect delivery.

Progressive difficulty
🪐
Planet Gravity

Each planet has a unique gravity field. Land, orbit, launch — your exit angle determines your fate.

📦
Delivery Mechanic

Carry a fragile box to the flag planet. Box health determines your star rating — 80%+ for 3 stars.

☄️
Asteroid Storms

Starting level 4, asteroids escalate from slow singles to relentless multi-rock swarms at level 20+.

🗺️
Map & Hint System

Zoom out to plan your route. One trajectory hint per level — use it wisely at the critical moment.
